- `d:\Antigravity\CatStay Platform\packages\backend\src\modules\inventory\inventory.service.ts` -- Products CRUD, stock transactions with automatic stock updates, low-stock alerts
- `d:\Antigravity\CatStay Platform\packages\backend\src\modules\inventory\dto\create-product.dto.ts`
- `d:\Antigravity\CatStay Platform\packages\backend\src\modules\inventory\dto\update-product.dto.ts` -- Note: `currentStock` is intentionally excluded from updates (stock should only change via transactions)
- `d:\Antigravity\CatStay Platform\packages\backend\src\modules\inventory\dto\create-stock-transaction.dto.ts` -- Enum for `type` (stock_in, stock_out, adjustment), `quantity` (min 1), optional `reason`

| GET | `hotels/:slug/inventory/alerts` | `inventory.view` |

**Key design decisions:**
- Stock transaction `createTransaction` uses `this.db.$transaction()` to atomically create the transaction record and update `product.currentStock` together

- Product delete is soft delete (sets `isActive = false`)
- `UpdateProductDto` intentionally omits `currentStock` -- stock changes must go through the transaction endpoint to maintain an audit trail
- Transaction response includes `previousStock` and `newStock` for immediate feedback

- Stock transaction `createTransaction` uses `this.db.$transaction()` to atomically create the transaction record and update `product.currentStock` together

- Product delete is soft delete (sets `isActive = false`)
